The Promise to His Father That Changed a Future CEO’s Life
summary: ServiceNow Chairman and CEO Bill McDermott recalls how, as a young man, he landed his first job at Xerox. He recounts the promise he made to his father, the unconventional job interview that followed and the moment that changed the course of his career. McDermott shared the story with Alan Murray at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Florida.
